reason: I already pay for Smoobu and the agency, and my guests come back because they talk to me, not a machine. Another €35 a unit on top, times four or five apartments, is real money for something I mostly do myself already.
objection: My guests like the personal touch. If a robot answers and gets something wrong about parking or check-in, they blame me in the review, and I am paying twice for guest messages.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked inside Smoobu so it only takes the boring Wi-Fi and parking questions in German off me, and I could see a neighbour on the coast using it a full August without guest complaints.
